findings.description: batchMint pays the contract's ENTIRE pre-loop balance of every whitelisted nudge token to a caller-chosen `recipient` on a count-only gate (`count >= nudgeSize`), decoupled from the value the caller contributed. This is the historical BatchNFTMinter nudge class: a permissionless caller who clears the size gate front-runs / sweeps a legitimately-funded pot (valid MEV finding under Law 1), and over-funding the pot is an owner footgun (Law 3).
matchedSignatures: caller-chosen recipient paid full pot (_payRewards line 547)
presentMitigations: Pot snapshotted BEFORE the mint loop (_snapshotRewards line 410, paid line 434) — closes the donation self-refund leg (notVulnerableWhen: 'pot snapshotted BEFORE the loop'). test_OwnDonationsDoNotRefundToBatcher pins this.

Caller must genuinely pay for >= nudgeSize real mints (payment pulled line 413, mint loop line 419) — the pot is not free; per memory the minted NFT has NO redemption value, so the qualifying spend is a real sunk cost (~6.7x margin).
missingMitigations: Recipient is still caller-chosen (not pinned to a non-caller address)
Payout still gated on count only, not compared to the value the caller contributed
findings.reconciliation: KNOWN / previously-triaged class — reconciles to the BatchNFTMinter nudge ledger history (H-01 story-014 fix; 858e9e80 wont-fix, run-21). This is a regression-anchor match on the story-025 multi-token whitelist rework, NOT a claim of a new vulnerability. Sanitizer to reconcile by fingerprint against the ledger; do not re-report as novel if already dispositioned.

manualReview.description: emergencyWithdraw() skips _syncBudget/_updatePool and does not recompute the schedule; it moves the exiting user's pending from committedDebt back into rewardBudget (forfeit recycles). This is the standard masterchef escape hatch and matches the historical M-02 'survivor over-emission' class. In the depletion model rewardRate = budget/window is totalStaked-INDEPENDENT, so a leaver does not directly re-rate survivors, but the forfeited-pending recycle + no in-place accRewardPerShare re-bake warrants a reconcile against the M-02 wont-fix disposition rather than silent acceptance.
manualReview.reconciliation: Reconcile to NFTStaker emergencyWithdraw over-emission M-02 (memory: phoenix-nft-staking-emergencywithdraw-overemission, WON'T-FIX 2026-06-09). V2 inherits the same escape-hatch design. Routed for human/higher-tier adjudication, not dropped.

manualReview.description: setNudgeTokenWhitelist uses swap-and-pop on remove, REORDERING _nudgeTokens (documented lines 202-204, 218-220). batchMint binds minRewards[i] positionally to _nudgeTokens[i]; a caller using a stale ordering supplies a per-token floor against the wrong token. Value impact is bounded — minRewards is only a floor and the whole balance is paid regardless — so this is a UI/ordering footgun, not a protocol value leak. Surfaced (not dropped) for triage completeness.
manualReview.reconciliation: No prior ledger entry located; low value-impact ordering hazard. Route to human triage.

noHitNotesForHistoricalClasses.evidence: NFTStakerDepletionV2._updatePool (lines 460-484) does NOT recompute rewardRate inside per-interaction accrual — rate is re-derived only in setDepletionWindow/_syncBudget/_recomputeSchedule (explicit comment lines 456-459: 'Recomputing the rate inside per-interaction accrual was phlimbo's V1 bug'). elapsed capped at min(now,windowEnd)-lastRewardTime (line 474-475); reward clamped to rewardBudget (line 477). All notVulnerableWhen conditions present.

noMatchNotes.REWARD-ACCRUAL-ORDER: _updatePool/_syncBudget runs at head of stake/unstake/claim/depositFor before share mutation; setDepletionWindow settles at OLD rate (line 378) before mutating; accPerShare bounded to [lastRewardTime, min(now,windowEnd)]. All notVulnerableWhen present.
noMatchNotes.REWARD-RUNWAY-DEPLETION: elapsed capped at min(now,windowEnd)-lastRewardTime (V2 lines 474-475); reward clamped to rewardBudget (line 477); _safePayTo reverts on shortfall (line 621, no silent cap); solvency invariant balance==rewardBudget+committedDebt maintained.
noMatchNotes.MINT-ON-DEMAND-OVERMINT: Single _updatePool writer folds in exactly elapsed*rate; mint path is dispatcherHook.pull() measured by balance delta (line 440-442), recompute uses V-committedDebt (line 535). No double-mint path.
noMatchNotes.REENTRANCY-ERC721-RECEIVE / CROSS-FUNCTI: All stake/unstake/claim/depositFor/batchMigrate/userMigrate/emergencyWithdraw are nonReentrant; _exitPosition zeroes position before ERC1155 transfer (CEI). batchMint is nonReentrant; payout after mint loop. Contract-wide guard covers the sibling set.
noMatchNotes.WEAK-PRNG: The 20 block.timestamp references in V2 are all accrual/window math (windowEnd, elapsed, lastRewardTime) — no value-bearing random outcome derived from block state.
noMatchNotes.YIELD-PRINCIPAL-ACCOUNTING-SKEW: No yield-strategy exit / requested-vs-received balance-delta principal path; depletion budget is idle rewardToken + hook mintDebt (settle-and-freeze migration, no strategy unwind).
noMatchNotes.FEE-ON-TRANSFER-ACCOUNTING: rewardToken is phUSD (protocol token, non-fee); staked asset is a single ERC1155 id counted by units, not ERC20 wei. dispatcherHook.pull() inflow measured by balance delta (line 440-442).
